skill.displayName: Big8 · 算八字·玄学算命助手（八字排盘·算命·风水·面相·星座·每日一卦）| Chinese Fortune Telling, Feng Shui & BaZi

llm.summary: This is a disclosed fortune-telling and image-reading skill with no evidence of malware, persistence, credential access, or hidden data exfiltration, but users should be cautious with selfie and birth-data inputs.

dimensions.detail: The advertised purpose and capabilities are coherent: feng shui image reading, face reading, BaZi, zodiac, divination, and almanac outputs all match the skill description and bundled knowledge files.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill asks the agent to analyze uploaded rooms, selfies, birth dates, time, and sometimes gender; those inputs fit the purpose, but the male default and Asia/Shanghai date default can produce inaccurate or biased readings when the user has not confirmed them.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown instructions, one Python helper, and YAML knowledge files. The inspected script performs local calendar, zodiac, and random-hexagram calculations and shows no network calls, credential access, file writes, destructive commands, or persistence setup.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Vision-based image analysis is proportionate to the advertised image-reading features, but face photos and birth details are sensitive, and the artifacts do not fully specify the Vision Model provider or platform retention behavior.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill states that photos are not stored or transferred, and the code does not persist user images or derived data. The broad third-party privacy assurance is not technically enforced by the artifact itself, so users should rely on the host platform's image-processing terms.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sharing photos, selfies, birth date/time, and optional gender with the host agent's vision and language model processing. Treat all readings as entertainment, provide your actual timezone for date-sensitive results, and avoid uploading identifiable face photos if you are not comfortable with the platform's image-processing policy.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] expected: The artifact does route image understanding through a Vision Model, which is expected for this skill. The plan's absolute statement that face images are not uploaded to any third party is under-substantiated rather than evidence of malicious behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: Using a timezone is necessary for date-dependent almanac and yearly readings. The Asia/Shanghai default is disclosed, but users outside that timezone should provide their location or timezone for accurate results.
[SQP-3] unexpected: Automatically defaulting unspecified gender to male is unnecessary and can affect BaZi outputs; this is a quality and fairness concern, not evidence of hidden access or malware.
[SQP-2] expected: Selfie-based face reading is central to the advertised feature and is disclosed, but the skill should make the sensitivity of face-photo processing and the entertainment-only nature of the output more prominent.
